processing_gaps.reason: This instruction appends its final-status input 1 to status_file, preserves existing content, and precedes the first-fast success return. Its output 0 denotes that path's resulting file state. The write primitive has no post-state output, so the complete instruction cannot be represented with a valid output binding. The status cannot stand for the whole resulting file, and no file-content read is supported. The append exposes the appended status without establishing acquisition or exposure of previous contents.

This instruction appends its retry-success final-status input 1 to status_file, preserves existing content, and precedes the retry-body return. Its output 0 denotes this alternative post-state of the same file. The write primitive has no post-state output, so the complete instruction cannot be represented with a valid output binding. Aliasing the status would misrepresent the resulting file, and no file-content read is supported. Only the appended status is established as content delivered by this append.
